const m = $('Merge Into blogs.json').item.json;
return [{ json: { ok: true, title: m.title, primaryKeyword: m.primaryKeyword, keywordModel: m.keywordModel, blogModel: m.blogModel, wordCount: m.wordCount, url: 'https://dhinova.com' + m.path } }];
